options.text: Yes, that seems like a good idea.

steps.text: Player is teleported to ScapeRune prison

standard-dialogue-island-version.npc: Hey, [player name], come with me if you like fishing! Or has this amulet of humanspeak broken again?

options.text: Yes, that seems like a good idea.

steps.text: Player is teleported to Evil Bob's Island

standard-dialogue-when-talking-to-anothe.text: Evil Bob doesn't seem interested in you.

in-scaperune-prison-room-continuation-af.speaker: Prison Pete
in-scaperune-prison-room-continuation-af.text: Yes, Evil Bob captured me and stuck me in this prison.

in-scaperune-prison-room-continuation-af.player: How do I get out of here? I can't be held captive by a cat!

in-scaperune-prison-room-continuation-af.speaker: Prison Pete
in-scaperune-prison-room-continuation-af.text: Some of these balloon animals have keys in them, and if you pull the big lever it tells you which shape animal contains the correct key, but I can never find it.

in-scaperune-prison-room-continuation-af.speaker: Prison Pete
in-scaperune-prison-room-continuation-af.text: You need to pull the lever to find out which shape animal contains the key, then pop that sort of animal to get the key.

in-scaperune-prison-room-continuation-af.speaker: Prison Pete
in-scaperune-prison-room-continuation-af.text: Bring me any keys you get and I'll try them on the doors.

options.text: But I want to leave now.

steps.player: But I wan't to leave now.

steps.speaker: Prison Pete
steps.text: Oh. Well I guess you can leave but I'll still be stuck here.

steps.speaker: Prison Pete
steps.text: Don't you remember? This is ScapeRune's prison. Evil Bob caught you and brought you here.

steps.player: What gives him the right to lock me up? I demand to see a lawyer! I know my rights!

steps.speaker: Prison Pete
steps.text: Evil Bob doesn't care about people's rights. He's cruel and utterly merciless. He's a cat.

in-scaperune-prison-room-when-trying-to-.speaker: Prison Pete
in-scaperune-prison-room-when-trying-to-.text: Oi! we'll be using the exit that's over here.

in-scaperune-prison-room-when-attempting.speaker: Prison Pete
in-scaperune-prison-room-when-attempting.text: You're meant to pull the lever to find out which sort of animal to pop!

in-scaperune-prison-room-when-pulling-th.speaker: Prison Pete
in-scaperune-prison-room-when-pulling-th.text: That's right, pull it. Then remember what kind of animal shape you see. That's the animal that contains the right key.

in-scaperune-prison-room-when-popping-a-.text: If the player does not have a Prison key:

steps.text: a prison key

steps.speaker: Prison Pete
steps.text: Great, now you've got a key! Bring it to me so I can try it on the doors.
The player walks to Prison Pete

steps.speaker: Prison Pete
steps.text: Ooh, thanks! I'll see if it's the right one...
Player gives Prison Pete the key.
If the key was from the wrong shape of balloon animal:

steps.speaker: Prison Pete
steps.text: Aww, that was the wrong key! You must have popped the wrong sort of animal. Try the big lever again - it'll tell you which animal to pop.
If the key was from the correct shape of balloon animal:
If it wouldn't unlock the last gate:

steps.speaker: Prison Pete
steps.text: Hooray, you got the right one! Now pull the lever again and let's get the next portal unlocked!

steps.speaker: Prison Pete
steps.text: You did it, you got all the keys right! Thank you! You're my friend FOREVER!

steps.player: Let's get out of here before that cat notices.

in-scaperune-prison-room-when-popping-a-.text: If the player has a Prison key in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Prison Pete
steps.text: Hey, bring me that key you've got! I wanna get out of here!

in-scaperune-prison-room-when-leaving-th.text: Player is teleported back to their original spot

in-scaperune-prison-room-when-leaving-th.speaker: Prison Pete
in-scaperune-prison-room-when-leaving-th.text: Thanks a lot for your help! Here, have a present:

in-scaperune-prison-room-when-talking-to.speaker: Prison Pete
in-scaperune-prison-room-when-talking-to.text: Don't mind me, I was just leaving...

on-evil-bob-s-island-continuation-after-.npc: I am your leader, you are but a slave!

on-evil-bob-s-island-continuation-after-.player: I am not a slave, I am a free person!

on-evil-bob-s-island-talking-with-evil-b.npc: I will never let you go, [player name]!

steps.npc: Uhm...
Because I say so! And because I can never have enough servants!
Now catch me some fish, I'm hungry.
Talk to my other servants, and hurry it up!
Sit down and I'll tell you. It's a question of servant shortage.
You are a skilled worker. A human like you is worth a great deal as a slave.

steps.player: A slave?? I will have nothing to do with you. Is that clear? Absolutely nothing.

steps.npc: Now be reasonable little human. It's just a matter of time before you will do everything I ask you to. Play along and this can be a very nice place.

steps.player: I will not make any deals with you. I'm a human. I will not be pushed, numbered, meowed at, teleported or enslaved. My life is my own.

steps.npc: Is it?
Won't I?
Let me assure you there's no way out.
Just ask my servants!

options.text: How is it possible that you're talking?

steps.player: How is it possible that you're talking?

steps.npc: How is it possible that you're not meowing?

steps.player: Meowing?? Why would I be meowing?

steps.npc: Most humans do, that's why I'm wearing this amulet of Man speak... but I do try to train my staff in civilised speech.
Ah, but I suppose things are slightly different in your world... what a dreadful place that must be.

steps.player: I think I'm getting a headache...

options.text: What did you do to Bob?

steps.player: What did you do to Bob?

steps.npc: Bob? I am Bob!
Oh, you mean the Bob in your world? Nothing. I am an incarnation of Bob here on ScapeRune.

steps.player: What, you mean this is... like some kind of mirror land?

steps.npc: Something like that... somewhere in ScapeRune there must be a human servant called [player name].
But you work just as well for me! Now get to work, human! Fish for me!

on-evil-bob-s-island-upon-catching-a-fis.text: You catch a... what is this?? Is this a fish?? And... it's cooked already??

on-evil-bob-s-island-attempting-to-eat-t.text: It looks vile and smells even worse. You're not eating that!

on-evil-bob-s-island-using-a-fishlike-th.npc: What, are you giving me cooked fish? What am I going to do with that? Uncook it first!
You heard me! There's the cold fire, by the trees, now get uncooking!

on-evil-bob-s-island-using-a-raw-fishlik.text: If the player has the wrong fishlike thing:

steps.npc: What was this? That was absolutely disgusting!
Don't you know what kind of fish I like? Talk to my other servants for some advice.

on-evil-bob-s-island-using-a-raw-fishlik.text: If the player gives Bob the final fishlike thing:

steps.npc: Mmm, mmm... that's... mmm... delicious...
Now, let me take... a little... catnap...
ZZZzzz

steps.text: Evil Bob falls asleep.

on-evil-bob-s-island-using-a-raw-fishlik.text: If the player needs to give Bob more fishlike things:

steps.npc: Mmm, mmm... that's delicious.
Now get me another one, you no good human!

on-evil-bob-s-island-using-anything-else.npc: What am I to do with that? Catch me some fish, puny human!

steps.npc: Mew!
Yowl!
Meeeow!
Meeeeow!

overhead-dialogue.text: If the player does not respond in time:

steps.npc: Meeeeowby laaaater...
